verdict_rationale: A=negative, B=negative, C=inconclusive. Applied bucket_aggregation_override rule-ownership_verifier-bucket_aggregation_override-1c25c: (neg, neg, inconclusive) → unowned. Standard table would yield 'unknown' but override promotes to 'unowned' because the only inconclusive signal (C) is structural (generic AWS CNAME) rather than informational. Corroborating evidence: PlayCanvas org consistently uses domain-named S3 buckets (static.playcanvas.com, apps.playcanvas.com) in eu-west-1; the bare 'playcanvas' bucket in ap-southeast-1 is inconsistent with their naming convention and region.
